description.value: A Trail landmark since 1896, The Arlington is a family-friendly bar and grill sitting two blocks from the Columbia River at the corner of Spokane St and Bay Ave in downtown Trail. Under its current owners since 2005, it serves a menu of nearly 100 elevated pub-fare items covering breakfast through dinner seven days a week. A sunny patio, a large interior with capacity for over 200 guests, and weekend live music and karaoke make it a lively stop in the heart of the Kootenays.
